items.title: Maps out of an almost free module to a bounded below complex in the derived category

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma concerns an almost free module in the sense of the surrounding section and a bounded below complex, and identifies the maps out of the former into the latter up to homotopy with the maps of the underlying graded module, using that the almost free module has a filtration whose associated graded pieces are direct sums of free modules shifted (source statement span). The proof has to lift a map defined on the associated graded pieces through the filtration, which uses that the complex is bounded below so that the intervening obstructions vanish one degree at a time; the two cited derived-category lemmas supply the standard step that maps from a projective complex and into an injective complex compute the relevant Hom groups (proof span).
